manifest_description: SceneNav AI Real-World Aerial Benchmark composed of authentic USGS/USDA NAIP public domain aerial orthophotos. Distinguishes verified planar ground truth, uncalibrated real observations with unavailable ground truth, and unrelated cross-scene negative pairs.
important_disclaimer: Metrics in this report reflect image-matching performance on the named dataset. For synthetic and planar-crop pairs, corner error is a pixel-level metric only. These results do NOT constitute evidence of real-world geographic navigation accuracy.
